The dark is casting. 🖤⚡

Cabana Bass Productions is building Tri-Cities' one-of-a-kind EDM haunted walkthrough for the 2026 season — and they need bodies, voices, and talent to bring it to life. Actors. Artists. Dancers. DJs. Security. Stage & lighting crew. If you've got something to show the dark, this is your call.

Walk into Azúcar, meet the crew behind the madness, and audition live. No callbacks in your inbox — just show up ready. This is how legends get built before the fog machines even turn on. 💀🔊

📅 Wednesday, September 30 | 7PM–11PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free
🔞 21+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #CabanaBass #CastingCall #HauntSeason2026 #PascoWA #TriCitiesEvents #AuditionNight

Fog curling under purple light. Frankenstein green glowing off the walls. Bass humming low, like something waking up underground. 🟣💀

Azúcar shifts into something else entirely for this one — half audition room, half haunted preview, all electric. You feel it the second you walk in: the room buzzing with dancers stretching, actors running lines under their breath, DJs testing drops that'll rattle your chest come haunt season. Every corner's alive with someone chasing a spot in something bigger than a Wednesday night.

This is the energy behind the scenes of Tri-Cities' first EDM haunted walkthrough — raw, a little chaotic, completely magnetic. Come feel it before it becomes legend. 🕸️🔊

📅 Wednesday, September 30 | 7PM–11PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free
🔞 21+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #CabanaBass #HauntSeason2026 #PascoWA #EDMHaunt #NightVibes #TriCitiesEvents

Doesn't matter if you've never stepped on a stage or you've been performing since you could walk — the dark doesn't care about your resume, it cares about your energy. 🖤

Cabana Bass Productions is opening the doors to Tri-Cities' creatures-to-be: actors who can hold a scene, dancers who can move a room, artists who see monsters differently, DJs who can drop the perfect drop, crews who keep the whole machine running. Come as you are. Bring your weird, your bold, your unfinished — that's exactly what they're casting for.

This is community built one audition at a time, all under Azúcar's roof. Show up, show out, see what happens. 🎃🔊

Actors. Artists. Dancers. DJs. Security. Stage & lighting crew. In-person auditions, no appointment drama — just walk in ready to show what you've got. Come ready to show them what you bring to the dark. 🖤
